evidence_request_times.name: evidence_request_times
evidence_request_times.value: "evidence_request"."drafted_at" >= "evidence_request"."received_at" AND "evidence_request"."approved_at" >= "evidence_request"."drafted_at" AND "evidence_request"."replied_at" >= "evidence_request"."received_at" AND "evidence_request"."replied_at" >= "evidence_request"."drafted_at" AND "evidence_request"."replied_at" >= "evidence_request"."approved_at" AND ("evidence_request"."approved_at" IS NULL OR "evidence_request"."drafted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("evidence_request"."replied_at" IS NULL OR "evidence_request"."drafted_at" IS NOT NULL)

grade_call_or_night.name: grade_call_or_night
grade_call_or_night.value: num_nonnulls("grade"."call_id", "grade"."night_id") = 1 OR ("grade"."call_id" IS NULL AND "grade"."night_id" IS NULL AND "grade"."window_id" IS NOT NULL)

export_job_object_path_under_org.name: export_job_object_path_under_org
export_job_object_path_under_org.value: "export_job"."object_path" IS NULL OR "export_job"."org_id" IS NULL OR "export_job"."object_path" LIKE 'orgs/' || "export_job"."org_id" || '/%'
